source: Lets make 3d game with floating island kingdoms with waterfalls,brigdes and a giant crystal castle and around the island you can find 5 diffrent temples with 5 diffrent bosses you can fight and earn coins to unlock new weapons and when you first start make the player equip a katana and when the equip it make some mobs spawn for them to fight so they can updgrade from a katana. also make it when you have 1,000 coins you can create your own clans to go out on adventures and experience and fight new enemies. also make the map 1,000,000,000,000 blocks big. and when you get enough xp make it so you can level up and unlock new maps and the max level right now is level 5,000.

image_prompt.text: The main floating island kingdom around the crystal castle, free of hostile mobs, where players restock between temple runs
A tight cluster of weapon vendor and coin exchange near the castle so upgrading from the starting katana does not cost a long walk
Open clearings on the islands holding mob spawns, set back from the bridges so low-level players are not ambushed in transit
Highly visible level-gated blockades on the routes to higher-tier islands, physically stopping under-levelled players
The giant crystal castle, visible from every island so players can orient themselves across the sky
floating island kingdoms suspended in the sky with waterfalls pouring off their edges into the void
bridges spanning the gaps between the floating islands
five distinct temples set around the islands, each an arena for its own boss

layout_placement.text: Mob emitters inside the clearings, including the wave that spawns at the starting area the moment the player equips the katana
five boss encounter volumes, one inside each temple

notes: The map size asked for - 1,000,000,000,000 blocks - cannot be framed in a single top-down image, or in any finite number of them. Treated as 'as large as feels endless' and routed at region scale; if literal extent matters this has to be decomposed into separate maps.
Floating islands with open sky beneath them are overhanging by definition, which is why P2 is on the route on top of the hub-and-dungeon P4 + P3.
'Unlock new maps' at higher levels implies additional maps beyond this build; only the starting world is described here.

open_questions.ask: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level?
Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want?
Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge?

answers.ask: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level?
answers.answer: Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.

answers.ask: Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want?
answers.answer: Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.

answers.ask: Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge?
answers.answer: Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.
